source_name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program Georeferenced Event Dataset
coverage: event-level organized violence aggregated by the Stage 2 adapter to country-year
years_available: 1989-2022 for the ingested GED 23.1 bundle; current Organized Violence 26.1 and One-sided Violence 26.1 archives are staged but not yet normalized by this adapter
